summary: Excellent PowerShell module design with pure function pattern, proper Set-StrictMode, parameter validation, meaningful errors. Workflow uses pinned action refs, least-privilege permissions, job dependency, sensible triggers (03:17 UTC schedule). Minor: $getPolicy closure slightly cryptic; explicit size summation loops avoid Measure-Object StrictMode edge case (appropriate). Workflow references ArtifactCleanup.Tests.ps1 (test file, out of scope). Modular, maintainable, ship-ready.
